text:
Lena (AE): Handoff: ClearPath Medical closed today. Deployment: Dedicated with private peering; must be in us-east-1 due to data residency. Customer asks: SAML SSO, KMS integration, audit-forward to their Splunk, and a security walkthrough before any PHI ingest. They want a 30m clinician pilot the week after next. Renewal/contract window is Q2; procurement lead time noted as a renewal risk if onboarding slips >14 days. Need a CSM owner + clear escalation to eng.

Omar (CSM): I can take this. Please drop AWS acct and SAML metadata. I'll prep an enablement + security walkthrough deck and capture their top 6 clinician prompts ahead of pilot. Also want expected concurrency to size capacity.

Felix (SE): Staging cluster spun up in dedicated-useast1. Missing customer's VPC CIDR and SAML metadata. Recommend starting with int8 quant for pilot to reduce cost. I'll post SG + route snippets.

Dana (Support): Opening infra ticket: <https://redwood.example.com/tickets/71234|ticket-71234>. Tags: clearpath, dedicated, splunk, kms, phipilot. Assigning to Felix + infra-team. ETA triage 4h. notify-bot will post status updates here. :gear:

Lena (AE): Customer contact: security@clearpath.health, AWS acct 777888999000. They asked for a security checklist before the walkthrough and confirmed their procurement team requires a signed DPA before any PHI. Omar - include that in the onboarding checklist.

Omar (CSM): Will do. Tentatively scheduling security walkthrough + enablement Thu 10am ET; will confirm after ticket shows peering validated. Owners: Omar = CSM/onboarding; Felix = infra; Dana = support triage; Lena = sales escalation & DPA follow-up. Any objections?

Felix (SE): Peering route example I'll add to ticket-71234:

```
# Customer route to accept peering
Destination: 10.100.0.0/16
Target: pcx-0f4e3d2c1b
```

Felix (SE): Uploading SG rules, KMS key policy template, and a small model footprint matrix to the ticket. Also recommending prefix KV caching for clinician templates to cut token usage.

notify-bot: ticket-71234 status: created -> triage_pending. Next update expected ~3-4h.

Dana (Support): Ticket linked to onboarding doc: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/clearpath. I'll block the pilot demo until peering + SAML metadata validated. Will run a smoke test and post results here. :white_check_mark:

Omar (CSM): Post-demo plan: I'll send a 3-question feedback form and capture any quality regressions for Research. Also adding renewal_watch in CRM given tight procurement timeline. Action items: Omar send invite after peering validated; Felix update ticket with SGs + KMS policy; Dana validate peering and run smoke; Lena follow up on DPA. Ping here if anything blocks.
